items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: the only two or three men who did play with us was Charlie Chaplin... they sat at the drums there but the only three men that I can remember who sat at the drums and played at Risenwebers

ctx.x: I've heard people mention Emil Gonzalez and different fellows I just wondered if they I didn't know him no I wondered if they did any fancy drumming in your day on the bass drumming parade

we were very very much annoyed by uh playboys who would want to come in and sit down on the drums this we couldn't allow because it messed the things up and it was awful difficult to play five men and have a drummer to beat certain tempos I guess the only two or three men who did play with us was Charlie Chaplin and the late Vernon Castle and Harold Lloyd they sat at the drums there but the only three men that I can remember who sat at the drums and played at Risenwebers well you couldn't refuse those people no…
a chaplain liked it too he could play a little did they have any uh banjos or guitars in those bands
